shudder_horror_popular_movies.title: Red Rooms
shudder_horror_popular_movies.description: The high-profile case of serial killer Ludovic Chevalier has just gone to trial, and Kelly-Anne is obsessed. When reality blurs with her morbid fantasies, she goes down a dark path to seek the final piece of the case’s puzzle.

shudder_horror_popular_movies.title: Exit 8
shudder_horror_popular_movies.description: A man trapped in an endless sterile subway passageway sets out to find Exit 8. The rules of his quest are simple: do not overlook anything out of the ordinary. If you discover an anomaly, turn back immediately. If you don’t, carry on. Then leave from Exit 8. But even a single oversight will send him back to the beginning. Will he ever reach his goal and escape this infinite corridor?

shudder_horror_popular_movies.title: Buffet Infinity
shudder_horror_popular_movies.description: As an endlessly expanding monster buffet threatens to engulf their small Alberta county, a group of local business owners star in low-budget TV commercials that conceal a sinister conspiracy and the emergence of unfathomable supernatural powers.

shudder_horror_popular_movies.title: Halloween
shudder_horror_popular_movies.description: Fifteen years after murdering his sister on Halloween Night 1963, Michael Myers escapes from a mental hospital and returns to the small town of Haddonfield, Illinois to kill again.

shudder_horror_popular_movies.title: Forbidden Fruits
shudder_horror_popular_movies.description: Free Eden employee Apple secretly runs a witchy femme cult in the basement of the mall store after hours - with fellow fruits Cherry and Fig. But when new hire Pumpkin challenges their performative sisterhood, the women are forced to face their own poisons or succumb to a bloody fate.

shudder_horror_popular_movies.title: Possession
shudder_horror_popular_movies.description: A young woman left her family for an unspecified reason. The husband determines to find out the truth and starts following his wife. At first, he suspects that a man is involved. But gradually, he finds out more and more strange behaviors and bizarre incidents that indicate something more than a possessed love affair.

shudder_horror_popular_movies.title: The Others
shudder_horror_popular_movies.description: Grace is a woman who lives in an old house kept dark because her two children, Anne and Nicholas, have a rare sensitivity to light. When the family begins to suspect the house is haunted, Grace fights to protect her children at any cost in the face of strange events and disturbing visions.

shudder_horror_popular_movies.title: Host
shudder_horror_popular_movies.description: Six friends hire a medium to hold a séance via Zoom during lockdown — but they get far more than they bargained for as things quickly go wrong. When an evil spirit starts invading their homes, they begin to realise they might not survive the night.

shudder_horror_popular_movies.title: Faces of Death
shudder_horror_popular_movies.description: A moderator on an internet video-sharing platform stumbles across a potential snuff film ring hidden in the depths of the site's content.

shudder_horror_popular_movies.title: Marama
shudder_horror_popular_movies.description: A young Maori woman arrives in Victorian Yorkshire seeking her family history, only to become trapped inside a manor where stolen heritage, buried secrets, and supernatural visions close around her.

shudder_horror_popular_series.title: The Terror
shudder_horror_popular_series.description: A chilling anthology series featuring stories of people in terrifying situations inspired by true historical events.

shudder_horror_popular_series.title: Tales from the Crypt
shudder_horror_popular_series.description: Cadaverous scream legend the Crypt Keeper is your macabre host for these forays of fright and fun based on the classic E.C. Comics tales from back in the day. So shamble up to the bar and pick your poison. Will it be an insane Santa on a personal slay ride? Honeymooners out to fulfill the "til death do we part" vow ASAP?

shudder_horror_popular_series.title: The Creep Tapes
shudder_horror_popular_series.description: A secluded serial killer lures videographers into his world with the promise of a paid job documenting his life. Unfortunately, as the tape rolls, the killer's questionable intentions surface with his increasingly odd behavior and the victims will learn they may have made a deadly mistake.

shudder_horror_popular_series.title: The Strain
shudder_horror_popular_series.description: A high concept thriller that tells the story of Dr. Ephraim Goodweather, the head of the Center for Disease Control Canary Team in New York City. He and his team are called upon to investigate a mysterious viral outbreak with hallmarks of an ancient and evil strain of vampirism. As the strain spreads, Eph, his team, and an assembly of everyday New Yorkers, wage war for the fate of humanity itself.

shudder_horror_popular_series.title: Channel Zero
shudder_horror_popular_series.description: A horror anthology series inspired by “Creepypasta” online tales.

shudder_horror_popular_series.title: Creepshow
shudder_horror_popular_series.description: A young boy's horror comic book comes to life in this anthology series of terrifying tales.

shudder_horror_popular_series.title: Hemlock Grove
shudder_horror_popular_series.description: One cannot quench his all-consuming thirst. The other cannot tame the beast clawing its way out. In the sleepy Pennsylvania village of Hemlock Grove, two young men struggle to accept painful truths: about family, themselves, the mystery of the White Tower - and a terrifying new threat so powerful it will turn them from predators into prey.

shudder_horror_popular_series.title: Chucky
shudder_horror_popular_series.description: After a vintage Chucky doll turns up at a suburban yard sale, an idyllic American town is thrown into chaos as a series of horrifying murders begin to expose the town’s hypocrisies and secrets. Meanwhile, the arrival of enemies — and allies — from Chucky’s past threatens to expose the truth behind the killings, as well as the demon doll’s untold origins.

shudder_horror_popular_series.title: Z Nation
shudder_horror_popular_series.description: Three years after the zombie virus has gutted the country, a team of everyday heroes must transport the only known survivor of the plague from New York to California, where the last functioning viral lab waits for his blood.

shudder_horror_popular_series.title: Slasher
shudder_horror_popular_series.description: Thirty years ago, in the sleepy community of Waterbury, a killer known as “The Executioner” murdered Sarah Bennett's parents. Now Sarah and her husband Dylan have returned to town, only to find herself the centerpiece in a series of horrifying murders centered around the seven deadly sins.

shudder_horror_new_movies.title: Saccharine
shudder_horror_new_movies.description: After succumbing to an obscure weight-loss craze involving the eating of human ashes, lovelorn medical student Hana finds herself haunted by the ghost of the person she's eating.

shudder_horror_new_movies.title: Penny Lane Is Dead
shudder_horror_new_movies.description: Set in 1986, during a scorching Aussie summer, three best friends' celebration at a beach house turns into a blood-soaked fight for survival when a prank goes horribly wrong.

shudder_horror_new_movies.title: The Mortuary Assistant
shudder_horror_new_movies.description: Follows Rebecca Owens, a mortuary science graduate who takes a night job at River Fields Mortuary. What begins as a routine job soon turns sinister as she faces terrifying supernatural forces.

shudder_horror_new_movies.title: Dolly
shudder_horror_new_movies.description: Young Macy is abducted by a deranged, monstrous figure who wants to raise her as its child.

shudder_horror_new_movies.title: Honey Bunch
shudder_horror_new_movies.description: Diana's husband is taking her to an experimental trauma facility deep in the wilderness, but she can't remember why... As her memories begin to creep back in so do some unwelcome sinister truths about her marriage.

shudder_horror_new_movies.title: Whistle
shudder_horror_new_movies.description: When a misfit group of unwitting high school students stumbles upon a cursed Aztec Death Whistle, they discover that blowing it unleashes a terrifying sound that summons their future deaths to hunt them down.

shudder_horror_new_movies.title: Mother of Flies
shudder_horror_new_movies.description: When a young woman faces a deadly diagnosis, she seeks dark magic from a witch in the woods - but every cure has costs.

shudder_horror_new_movies.title: Faces of Death
shudder_horror_new_movies.description: A moderator on an internet video-sharing platform stumbles across a potential snuff film ring hidden in the depths of the site's content.

shudder_horror_new_movies.title: Nightborn
shudder_horror_new_movies.description: In Finnish forest, Saga and her husband Jon embark on a new chapter as parents. But Saga's joy is overshadowed by a chilling suspicion about their newborn, unbeknownst to Jon, causing a rift as she alone grapples with the disturbing truth.

shudder_horror_new_movies.title: Bodycam
shudder_horror_new_movies.description: A call to a quiet suburban home unleashes unthinkable carnage when two officers mistakenly shoot a man and his infant child, spiraling the tragedy into a fierce, unrelenting fall into the unknown.

shudder_horror_new_series.title: Guts & Glory
shudder_horror_new_series.description: A new genre-bending series from special effects legend Greg Nicotero (“The Walking Dead”) dropping real, unsuspecting contestants into a terrifying, immersive horror movie. Survive the night or be eliminated.

shudder_horror_new_series.title: Hell Motel
shudder_horror_new_series.description: 10 true crime obsessives invited to the opening weekend of the newly renovated Cold River Motel, the site of a 30-year-old unsolved Satanic Mass Murder. History repeats itself when the guests start getting knocked off one by one.

shudder_horror_new_series.title: The Haunted Season
shudder_horror_new_series.description: From Severin Films and Kier-La Janisse, a new series of chilling short form horror in the tradition of telling ghost stories for Christmas. From Severin Films and renowned author, producer, and filmmaker Kier-La Janisse comes The Haunted Season. Created by Janisse, one new episode of The Haunted Season will arrive on Shudder each December with chilling short form horror tales in the tradition of telling ghost stories for Christmas.

shudder_horror_new_series.title: Horror's Greatest
shudder_horror_new_series.description: Embark on a thrilling journey through the genre's best with insights from the masterminds behind your favorite scares.

shudder_horror_new_series.title: The Creep Tapes
shudder_horror_new_series.description: A secluded serial killer lures videographers into his world with the promise of a paid job documenting his life. Unfortunately, as the tape rolls, the killer's questionable intentions surface with his increasingly odd behavior and the victims will learn they may have made a deadly mistake.

shudder_horror_new_series.title: The Boulet Brothers' Dragula: Titans
shudder_horror_new_series.description: This spin-off series of The Boulet Brothers' Dragula stars monster drag artists from the show's previous seasons returning to the competition for a chance to win a $100,000 grand prize and the title of Queen of the Underworld. Each week the returning drag monsters must compete in makeup, costume creation, and performance based challenges to prove that they are the best of the best, while the weakest among them must face terrifying physical feats or risk elimination until only the true Titan of Dragula remains.

shudder_horror_new_series.title: The 101 Scariest Horror Movie Moments of All Time
shudder_horror_new_series.description: In this Shudder Original series, master filmmakers and genre experts celebrate and dissect the most terrifying moments of the greatest horror films ever made, exploring how these scenes were created and why they burned themselves into the brains of audiences around the world.

shudder_horror_new_series.title: Queer for Fear: The History of Queer Horror
shudder_horror_new_series.description: A documentary telling the story of LGBTQIA+ horror and the relationship between queer audiences and horror, and the queer horror community as a whole.

shudder_horror_new_series.title: The Last Drive-In: The Walking Dead
shudder_horror_new_series.description: Join Joe Bob Briggs and special guest Greg Nicotero as they watch the first two episodes of The Walking Dead (2010) Season 1 and talk about the introduction and evolution of walkers, as well as iconic walkers from the series.

shudder_horror_new_series.title: Behind the Monsters
shudder_horror_new_series.description: A docu-series exploring how Chucky, Michael Myers, Pinhead and more came to be icons of the horror genre.
